summary: Verified the fix for the Gemini RECITATION bug ('AI:n svarade inte med giltig JSON på sida 5 av 6'). Added two new test files: (1) /app/backend/tests/test_strip_json.py – 14 unit tests covering strip_json (valid JSON, fenced ```json blocks, LaTeX backslash escapes like \sqrt / \alpha / \mathrm, raw newlines in strings, long truncated markdown salvage returning {markdown, truncated: True}, short truncated raising AIError 'giltig JSON', empty/whitespace raising 'tomt svar', garbage raising 'giltig JSON') and 3 async tests for call_ai Gemini branch (RECITATION + empty → AIError 'filter … RECITATION', SAFETY + empty → AIError 'filter', RECITATION + non-empty text → text passed through). All 14 unit tests PASS. (2) /app/backend/tests/test_recitation_e2e.py – full E2E against the live preview URL: login test@copythat.app/246810, GET /api/scanner for the key, POST /api/scanner/upload with the actual 'Sinnesorganen samlar information.pdf' as multipart file + X-Scan-Key header, poll /api/documents/{id} until all 6 pages terminal, assert zero pages in 'error' and that page 5 markdown contains 'Hörseln'. Test PASSED in 87 s. Backend logs confirm the exact fallback path: 'read attempt 1 with gemini failed: Gemini: svaret stoppades av Googles filter (RECITATION) – texten liknar upphovsrättsskyddat material', then OpenAI processed the page successfully. Document cleaned up afterwards. Also added /app/pytest.ini with asyncio_mode=auto so the async tests run cleanly in future iterations (pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 installed).
critical_code_review_comments: ai.strip_json: BAD_ESCAPE_RE correctly repairs raw LaTeX backslashes (\sqrt, \alpha, \mathrm) and json.loads(strict=False) accepts raw newlines/tabs — both verified by unit tests.

ai.strip_json: MD_FIELD_RE salvage path returns {markdown, truncated: True} only when the salvaged markdown is >200 chars, so a short unterminated JSON correctly raises AIError 'giltig JSON' instead of silently returning garbage.

ai.call_ai gemini branch: finishReason check correctly catches RECITATION / SAFETY / BLOCKLIST / PROHIBITED_CONTENT / OTHER only when the text is empty (if any text arrived we pass it through) — verified by three unit tests.
ai.read_page.primary_call: on 'filter' errors the provider is added to blocked set and the next provider in the chain is tried, which the E2E confirmed by falling back from gemini → openai on page 5.
Gemini maxOutputTokens is set to 65536 (ai.py:176) — sufficient to not hit MAX_TOKENS on the 6-page textbook test.
seed_data_creation: E2E created one scan document via POST /api/scanner/upload with the 6-page sinnesorganen PDF and deleted it in the test's finally block (verified via DELETE /api/documents/{id}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 is now installed and /app/pytest.ini sets asyncio_mode=auto, so async def tests work without decorators. Run full backend suite with: cd /app && pytest backend/tests/ -v --tb=short. The E2E test takes ~90 s because it makes real AI calls (Gemini + OpenAI fallback on page 5). AI keys for gemini + openai are configured via CommHub keychain; anthropic is NOT. Expected noise in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: 'read attempt 1 with gemini failed: … RECITATION' — this is the fix working, not a bug.
rca_of_issue: RCA: 'Sinnesorganen samlar information.pdf' page 5 contains verbatim Swedish textbook text about the ear ('Hörseln'). Google Gemini's safety classifier flagged it as potentially copyrighted and returned a response with finishReason=RECITATION and an empty content.parts array. The old parser treated the empty text as 'invalid JSON' and surfaced a confusing Swedish error to the user. Fix (/app/backend/ai.py): (a) call_ai's gemini branch now inspects finishReason; if it is RECITATION/SAFETY/BLOCKLIST/PROHIBITED_CONTENT/OTHER AND the text is empty, it raises AIError('… filter … <REASON>') so the caller can distinguish filter-block from parse failure; (b) read_page.primary_call now retries once on bad/empty JSON, but on filter blocks adds the provider to a 'blocked' set and falls back to the next available service (OpenAI). (c) strip_json repairs LaTeX backslash escapes (\sqrt, \alpha, \mathrm), accepts raw control chars (strict=False), and salvages a long truncated markdown field when the JSON object itself is unterminated. (d) Gemini generationConfig.maxOutputTokens raised to 65536. Reproduction: upload the 6-page PDF via /api/scanner/upload; expected observable: page 5 goes done (not error) and backend logs show one 'RECITATION' warning followed by a successful OpenAI read. Mitigation verified end-to-end in this iteration.
